Extract the ingredients and steps from this recipe: 'For a classic Spanish tortilla, peel and slice 4 medium potatoes thinly. Chop 1 onion. Fry both in plenty of olive oil for 15 minutes over medium heat. Beat 6 eggs in a large bowl with salt. Mix the potatoes and onion with the eggs and let stand 5 minutes. Pour into a hot pan with a little oil. Cook 4 minutes per side.'
